bullets.title: Foundations of Adult Medical-Surgical Nursing
bullets.text: Adult medical-surgical nursing focuses on caring for people who experience acute illness, chronic disease, injury or surgery. The nurse must understand the condition while also considering pain, mobility, nutrition, emotional wellbeing, family support and the person's ability to manage after discharge. Effective care…

bullets.title: Comprehensive Assessment & Clinical Reasoning
bullets.text: A thorough assessment provides the foundation for every nursing decision. Adult patients may deteriorate gradually, and early clues can be subtle. Clinical reasoning involves collecting cues, comparing them with the patient's baseline, interpreting their meaning and deciding what action is required.

bullets.title: Nursing Care for Common Medical Conditions
bullets.text: Adults commonly require nursing care for cardiovascular, respiratory, renal, gastrointestinal and endocrine conditions. The nurse's role includes monitoring, administering treatment, preventing complications, supporting function and teaching the patient how to manage the condition.

bullets.title: Surgical Nursing & Prevention of Complications
bullets.text: Surgical nursing begins before the procedure and continues through recovery and discharge.
